title: Every tile shows only the selected location's figures
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a fresh test location made for this run, so nothing else is invoiced, credited or clocked there; on the Dashboard, the Revenue tile on This Week reads $0.00 with 0 Invoices. This is location A.
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. A second location B you can switch to (any other location in the list).
  5. A test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101).
  6. In location A: one invoiced work order (not sent, not paid) for the test customer, one labor line of 3.00 hours at $100.00 an hour (Tech Time 3.00). You have written down its Subtotal (e.g. $300.00).
custom_steps:
1. With location A selected, click Dashboard. Set Revenue and Sales by Customer to This Week. Write down both headlines.
  2. Open Reports > Sales (Date: This week) for location A and write down the Totals row Subtotal.
  3. In the top bar switch to location B.
  4. On the Dashboard set Revenue and Sales by Customer to This Week and write down both headlines.
  5. Open Reports > Sales (Date: This week) for location B and write down the Totals row Subtotal.
  6. In the top bar switch back to location A and read the Dashboard again (This Week on both tiles).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Location A: Revenue reads $300.00 and Sales by Customer reads "1 customer", matching A's Sales report ($300.00).
  • After switching to B, every tile reloads with B's own figures. B's Revenue equals B's Sales report for This week and does not include A's $300.00 invoice.
  • Back on A, the figures return to $300.00 and "1 customer".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (S1), story SV-9575 (S3); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S1 (S1-R4, S1-E1), S3 (S3-R1). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 01_Opens_After (location name in the top bar).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “The dashboard shows figures for the workplace the user currently has selected in the top navigation.”
  • S1-E1: “If the user switches the selected workplace in the top navigation, the dashboard reloads its figures for the newly selected workplace.”
  • S3-R1: “Every figure the dashboard shows for a measure equals the figure the measure's matching report shows for the same workplace, date range, and filters. This holds at every moment, not merely in principle. The dashboard may serve a figure from a cache, but only in a way that cannot produce a difference: the tile and its report must resolve to the same stored calculation, or the cache must be invalidated by the same events that change the report's answer. A tile that shows a different number from its report because one of them is more recently computed than the other is a defect, not an accepted staleness window. There is no freshness allowance and no "up to N minutes behind" in this spec.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
